title: Website inquiries
description: Contact forms and callback requests from the website
noAccess: You don't have access to website inquiries.
notFound: This inquiry doesn't exist or was deleted.

empty.open: Nothing waiting. Every inquiry has an answer.
empty.answered: No answered inquiries waiting on the customer.

notDeliveredHint: The mail to the team inbox didn't go through. This page is the only copy, so reply from here.
overdueHint: Nobody has replied within one business day.
noReplies: No replies yet. Your reply is mailed to the customer and shown on their inquiry page.
replyHint: Sent to the customer right away. Ctrl + Enter sends.
stateHint: Opening an inquiry tells the customer nothing. Assigning it or setting “In progress” shows them someone is on it; they get one mail for that and one for “Answered”, a few minutes after the last change.
callbackConfirmedToast: Callback confirmed. The customer gets a calendar invite.
callbackCancelledToast: Callback cancelled. The customer has been told.
searchPlaceholder: Search by reference, name, email, company, phone or text…
noMatchesInTab: Only this tab was searched. Try “All”.
searchScope: Searched the 1,000 most recent inquiries. An exact reference is found however old it is.
tooLarge: Files can be up to 10 MB.

tags.title: Tags
tags.failed: Couldn't save the tags. Try again.

notes.label: Internal note
notes.placeholder: Only the team sees this. Handy for context, next steps or who to ask…
notes.hint: Never mailed or shown to the customer. Included if they ask for a copy of their data.

templates.title: Reply templates
templates.description: Canned replies the whole team shares, picked from “Templates” beside the reply box
templates.empty: No templates yet. Write the answers you give most often once, and reuse them.
templates.name: Name
templates.namePlaceholder: e.g. Thanks, we'll call you back
templates.placeholdersHint: Filled in when you pick it; empty ones are left out:
templates.deleteConfirm: It goes to the trash for 30 days, where you can restore it.
templates.pickOne: Pick a template or start a new one
templates.pickOneHint: Templates in the customer's language are listed first when you reply.

viewers.viewing: {count, plural, one {{names} has this open too.} other {{names} have this open too.}}

merge.hint: Move everything from {source} into {target} and close {source}
merge.confirm: Its message, replies, notes and tags move to {target}, and {source} is closed. The customer isn't mailed. This can't be undone.
merge.failed: Couldn't merge. Only inquiries from the same customer can be merged, and not a callback that's still to happen.
merge.banner: This inquiry was merged into <link>{reference}</link>. Reply there.

settings.title: Inbox settings
settings.description: These apply to everyone who works the website inbox.
settings.autoCloseHint: An answered inquiry the customer doesn't come back to is closed after this long, so “Answered” only lists what's still waiting on them. They aren't mailed, and replying opens it again.

stats.title: Inbox stats
stats.description: What came in, how fast it was answered and how long it stayed open
stats.flowHintWeek: Per week, the latest one ending today
stats.noTags: No tagged inquiries in this period.
stats.footnote: Times are calendar time from receiving to the first reply (or confirmed callback) and to closing, not business hours. Inquiries merged into another count once.
stats.truncated: Only the 5,000 most recently active inquiries were counted.
stats.noRatings: No customer has rated an answer in this period.

summary.title: Summary
summary.prompt: A few sentences on what the customer wants and where it stands.

draft.title: Reply draft
draft.prompt: A first draft in the customer's language. It goes into the reply box for you to check; [square brackets] mark what only you can fill in.
